title: PUFGuard: Explainable Answer Set Programming for Disclosure-Risk Screening of Public-Use Microdata
description: Replication package for the PUFGuard manuscript: the profiling-to-policy pipeline (Python), the Answer Set Programming rule base and generated facts, configuration files, cross-tool (sdcMicro) and ARX-equivalent verification, exhaustive finite-domain verification, robustness/mutation tests, post-cleanup second-stage assessment, the automated test suite, and machine-readable result tables. The five source datasets are not redistributed; they are referenced by DOI and SHA-256 and downloaded per the README.
